scientific_limitations_and_integrity: An exact formula only for the four-vertex quiver with outer arrow multiplicities a,c>=1 and a single middle arrow, with each projective occurring once. General five-step parabolic polynomiality was already established by Goodwin and Röhrle; the novelty assessment concerns the parameter-uniform closed count, not polynomiality. General pattern-group recursions provide potential fixed-size coverage. Direct finite-field computations check examples but are not used as an infinite proof. No independent audit or independent validation is claimed.
title: Commuting-pair counts for four-level quiver radicals with parallel outer arrows
